title: AEIB Target Evidence Reconciliation Contract v1
description: Versioned machine-readable schema for target-side settlement and refund reconciliation responses. Governs Station 2 probe reconciliation under strict mTLS or pinned public key authentication, requiring unredacted parameter parity against pre-dispatch CAID.

contract_version.description: Version of the refund status evidence contract.

operation_id.description: Operation identifier matching the original DISPATCH_INTENT.

idempotency_key.description: Unique idempotency key or CAID bound to the dispatch.

target_status.description: Authoritative target state. SETTLED maps to RESOLVED_CONFIRMED. REVERSED and REJECTED map to RESOLVED_REFUTED. PENDING and UNKNOWN preserve EFFECT_INDETERMINATE.

target_mutation_ref.description: Target-assigned external transaction or settlement reference identifier.

settled_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when target confirmed final state.

reversal_ref.description: Target reversal reference if state is REVERSED.

failure_reason.description: Target rejection or failure code if state is REJECTED.

parameter_parity.description: Consequential mutation parameters evaluated unredacted against pre-dispatch CAID.

amount_minor_units.description: Exact transaction amount in minor currency units (cents).

recipient_binding.description: Exact unredacted target recipient identifier (e.g. IBAN or account ID) bound to CAID.

authentication.description: Cryptographic authentication proof of target evidence.

channel.description: Authentication mechanism used by the status probe.

signature_hex.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature over canonical RFC 8785 status payload if PINNED_ED25519_SIGNATURE is used.
